name: qa-kit
description: QA, test-automation, and problem-clarifying plugins for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: qa-kit
plugins.description: Clarify and solve problems (grill-me, brainstorm, problem-solving, predict), generate test cases and edge cases, turn manual cases into Playwright tests with web-testing from-manual, write Vitest/k6 automation, run and audit suites, explore apps, and debug failures. Includes tester, debugger, code-reviewer, and brainstormer agents.
